scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,daemon,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/daemon" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/daemon && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
